$comment: c95 (Windows-host sub-arc, FLIP-AND-UNBLOCK): the pe-gated `_WIN32`/`_WIN64` predefined macros + the `__stdcall`/`WINAPI` erase + the shipped windows.json descriptor + the quote->angle include fallback, exercised end to end. The pe target predefines `_WIN32`, so `#if defined(_WIN32)` selects the Windows branch: it quote-`#include "windows.h"` (resolved to windows.json via the C 6.10.2p3 quote->angle fallback), declares a `DWORD __stdcall` function (parses only because `__stdcall` ERASES on pe), uses a HANDLE + the MAX_PATH constant, and assembles exit 42. Every non-pe target has NO `_WIN32` (the macro is availableObjectFormats:[pe]) so it compiles the `#else` branch — proving the mechanism is per-format-gated with no elf/macho/arm64 regression (the guarded include is skipped, so windows.json's pe-only availability is never hit off-pe). All four running targets share exit 42 (the manifest carries one exitCode); the pe route DERIVES it from windows.h facts while the else route returns it directly. RED-ON-DISABLE: removing `_WIN32` from c.lang.json's predefinedMacros flips the pe target onto the else path AND breaks the (now-unguarded-on-pe) windows.h resolution — witnessed in the c95 scratchpad (red_on_disable.txt).

optimizedPipelines.$commentByteIdentical: MEASURED 2026-08-15 — optimized image BYTE-IDENTICAL to the baseline on: arm64:elf64-aarch64-linux-exec, x86_64:elf64-x86_64-linux-exec. It DIFFERED on: x86_64:pe64-x86_64-windows-exec, so identity here is target-dependent and an arm-level opt-in (which applies to every target at once) would red the spec where it is identical. Legs actually run: windows/pe64-x86_64 and linux/elf64 (x86_64 + aarch64 under qemu); the darwin/macho64 leg was NOT run. Where the image is identical the arm's exit-code/stdout comparison is x==x and cannot fail. HONEST, AND FORMAT-DEPENDENT: this example's source is platform-conditional, and identity was MEASURED to disagree between legs for exactly that reason. The key is per-ARM and applies to EVERY target at once, so arming it on the strength of the leg where it differs would red the leg where it does not. The pe branch and the `#else` branch are two different programs behind `_WIN32`. Deliberately NOT given "mustDifferFromBaseline" — an honest no-op, not a missed opt-in.
